Dear Milk, My name is Kohoku (old mountain).
I am selling a figure of a character like the one in the URL, and I am in need of a new motif.
I am in need of an illustration of an innocent, thin-clothed girl, about JC in height, barefoot, full-body drawing, please.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nwJ55U55jM8KS5ACtXndjRf7x9bagzGA/view?usp=sharing

This request is for the purpose of borrowing the illustrator's free ideas.
If you are interested, please consider this request.
If the content is not suitable, please cancel the request.

Costume: simple and small, like the sample, just a thin cloth covered and tied.
The upper half of the garment should be open at the sides or back to show off the breasts, and the hem should be about the height of a super mini, with no sides like the sample, or with a slit or hole on the side to emphasize that the garment is "not worn".
If in doubt, please use a common slave or caveman outfit.
Please avoid full swimsuits and pants.

Pose: Pose like the girl by the window in the past work March 9, or the girl lying on the couch on November 22, 2021.
No underwear, so please hide it just barely with hems, tails, angles, etc.

Details such as facial expressions, hairstyles, etc. are up to you. We welcome kemokko.
(I think it would be good if the character comes out in the gesture, facial expression, hair style, shape of the clothes, and the way she wears them.

Since we are unable to reproduce detailed paint work or accessories, we ask that you keep clothing coloring and decoration simple.
Please focus on the silhouette.
The touch should be similar to that of a child reading a book at the top of the page, without strong shading.

We would also appreciate a very simple rough sketch from the direction where the clothes and hair are not visible (back, etc.).
If you have any doubts, please guess your favorite, your favorite, my character, etc.
With or without background is OK.

Thank you in advance for your consideration!
